statement: This sketch simulates a retro camera viewfinder from an early 2000s mobile phone, capturing the visual instability of outdated technology. The core aesthetic is created through a rapidly shifting, high-frequency noise-based background that flickers and distorts across the screen. As time progresses, the intensity and speed of these distortions increase, mimicking a device struggling to capture its environment. The effect is achieved using Perlin noise to generate dynamic color patterns, combined with periodic glitch-like visual artifacts and subtle canvas shifts that simulate physical instability. The viewer observes an increasingly chaotic yet controlled digital disturbance that evokes the aesthetic of aging tech attempting to process reality.
